query: I am evaluating an 89-year-old woman. Among female patients aged 84–94 admitted with ACS whose initial Troponin I exceeded the 99th percentile ULN, report counts and mean, median, IQR.
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_patients, AVG(value) AS average_troponin_i, MEDIAN(value) AS median_troponin_i, (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY value)) AS interquartile_range FROM labevents JOIN patients ON labevents.subject_id = patients.subject_id JOIN admissions ON labevents.subject_id = admissions.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_age = 89 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admissions.admittime) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND labevents.itemid = 87167880--3 AND value > percentile_cont(0.99) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) AND admissions.admission_type_id = 2100 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE subject_id = labevents.subject_id AND icd_code = 'ACS');
